vorbehalt: Reserved activities — tax returns, annual accounts, periodic filings and the tax assessment of your individual case — are carried out exclusively through a cooperating certified tax advisor.

lead.introduction: Leave us your details — we will come back to you with your result and suggest an appointment.
lead.consentement: I agree that WAMB'S Consulting may store and process my details and my simulation result in order to answer my enquiry. I may withdraw this consent at any time.
lead.mentionDonnees: We transmit your contact details and the key figures of this simulation — nothing else you entered.
lead.confirmationTitre: Thank you, we have received your enquiry
lead.confirmationTexte: The booking calendar opens in a new window. If it does not, use the link below.

hub.headline: Calculators that give you an indicative figure, not a brochure
hub.subline: Free calculators from a Berlin financial consultancy. No sign-up, available in English, German and French.
hub.trustMandanten: engagements in DE, FR and internationally
hub.privacy: Every calculation runs in your browser. What you enter leaves it only if you deliberately submit the contact form.

steuer.description: How much can you realistically get back? Ten profiles, from employee to parental leave.

bruttoNetto.description: What is left of your salary? Includes tax class comparison, church tax and employer cost.

honorar.titre: What does a tax adviser cost?
honorar.description: Your fee under the statutory StBVV schedule — itemised, with the legal basis for every line.

rechtsform.description: Four legal forms compared head to head: trade tax, corporation tax, director's salary and dividends.

kleinunternehmer.titre: Small business VAT exemption — or not?
kleinunternehmer.description: Section 19 VAT exemption against standard VAT, with the customer mix at which the answer flips.

firmenwagen.description: What the car actually costs you in net pay each month — including the quarter rate for electric vehicles.

immobilien.description: After-tax yield, depreciation, rental losses and the speculation period — for a property you intend to let.

kaufnebenkosten.description: Transfer tax, notary, land registry and agent — and how much equity you actually need.

photovoltaik.description: The 30 kWp limit of § 3 Nr. 72 EStG, the zero VAT rate on purchase, and what the system earns each year.

abfindung.description: The one-fifth rule, payment timing, and the 2025 change — your employer no longer applies it.

altersvorsorge.description: What you will be short in retirement, and what Rürup or Riester really cost after tax and subsidies.

erbschaft.description: Allowances, tax class and the ten-year rule — with the effect of transferring in stages.

erklaerungspflicht.titre: Do I have to file a tax return?
erklaerungspflicht.description: Mandatory filing under § 46 EStG and your deadline under § 149 AO — with and without a tax adviser.

unterhalt.titre: Money sent to family back home
unterhalt.description: Supporting parents abroad is deductible — with the country group, the Opfergrenze cap and the evidence most claims fail on.

kindergeldAusland.titre: Child benefit for children living abroad
kindergeldAusland.description: EU, treaty state or third country: three completely different answers — plus the allowance that survives without benefit.

rentenerstattung.titre: Going home: claim your contributions back?
rentenerstattung.description: The § 210 SGB VI refund against your pension entitlement — a decision that cannot be undone.

bn.sousTitre: Your net salary including wage tax, solidarity surcharge, church tax and social security contributions.
bn.steuerklasseIndice: Shown on your payslip. Unsure? Single people are usually in class I.
bn.kirchensteuerIndice: 8 % in Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg, otherwise 9 % of the wage tax.
bn.kinderfreibetraegeIndice: 0.5 per child per parent. Affects only the solidarity surcharge and church tax, not the wage tax itself.
bn.enfantsMoins25Indice: From the second child onwards, the long-term care contribution drops by 0.25 points per child.
bn.sansEnfantIndice: Then the 0.6 % childless surcharge on long-term care insurance applies.
bn.zusatzbeitragIndice: Average {moyen} %. Your health fund can tell you the exact rate.
bn.primePriveeIndice: Only the basic tariff counts for tax. The employer subsidy is applied automatically.
bn.rvPflichtigIndice: Choose no if you are, for example, a controlling managing director or a civil servant.
bn.resultatSousTexte: {annuel} per year — that is {part} of your gross salary
bn.coutEmployeurIndice: Gross salary plus the employer's share of social security.
bn.revenuImposableIndice: After the employee allowance and the pension expense allowance (§ 39b EStG).
bn.comparaisonNote: The tax class only changes what is withheld during the year, not the final annual tax. Anything overpaid comes back through your tax return.
bn.coupleTitre: As a couple: which combination pays best each month?
bn.gainCoupleTitre: Up to {montant} more net per month
bn.gainCoupleTexte: That is the gap between the best and the worst tax class combination. You may switch once a year — in the meeting we place whether it could apply to you.
bn.alerteJAEGTitre: You are above the compulsory insurance threshold
bn.alerteJAEGTexte: At this income you may move to private health insurance. The decision binds you for decades, so it deserves to be calculated first.
bn.alerteKlasseVTexte: Withholding in class V is high by design. For classes V and VI this calculation approximates § 39b Abs. 2 EStG. Check whether class IV with factor suits you better.
bn.ctaTexte: In 15 minutes we place your tax class, your deductible expenses and the question of a possible refund in context — no obligation.
bn.avertissement: Non-binding estimate. Not included: benefits in kind, individual allowances granted by the tax office, one-off payments and the specifics of individual health funds.
bn.stand: Law as at {annee} · parameters verified on {date}

expat.titre: Moving to Germany — your tax position
expat.sousTitre: Arrival, departure or cross-border work: what it means for your tax liability, your rate and your tax class.
expat.q1Indice: What matters is where your residence or habitual abode is (§ 1 EStG).

arrivee.titre: I moved to Germany this year

resident.titre: I live in Germany all year

grenzgaenger.titre: I live abroad and work in Germany

expat.q2Titre: Which country do you come from — or live in?
expat.q2Indice: The double taxation treaty with that state decides which country may tax which income.
expat.q3Indice: If you arrive or leave mid-year, you are only subject to unlimited tax liability for part of the year — with noticeable consequences.
expat.moisResume: That means {mois} months of unlimited tax liability in Germany.
expat.q4Indice: Gross figures are enough — the calculator applies the allowances itself.
expat.q4IndiceFrontalier: As a cross-border commuter, enter only the salary earned in Germany.
expat.revenuAllemandIndice: Salary or profit during the German period.
expat.revenuEtrangerIndice: This income is not taxed in Germany, but it raises your tax rate (§ 32b EStG).
expat.conjointAlEtrangerIndice: Within the EU/EEA, joint assessment is still possible (§ 1a EStG).
expat.revenuConjointIndice: It partly determines whether the 90 percent threshold is met.
expat.enfantsIndice: German child benefit is generally payable even if the children live in another EU country.
expat.resEconomieSousTexte: Available through joint assessment under § 1a EStG — but it has to be claimed.
expat.resSurcoutEtiquette: Extra cost from exemption with progression
expat.resSurcoutSousTexte: This is what your foreign income costs you in German tax, even though it stays tax-free itself.
expat.resChiffrageIndice: Estimated using the standard scale of § 32a EStG.
expat.resAvecSplittingIndice: After applying and submitting the EU/EEA certificate.

assujettissementMixte.titre: You have unlimited tax liability for only {mois} months
assujettissementMixte.texte: For the rest of the year you count as having limited liability. Both periods are combined in a single tax return.

progressionvorbehalt.texte: Your foreign income stays tax-free in Germany but lifts your tax rate to {taux}. It catches out almost every newcomer on their first tax assessment.

grenzgaengerFR.texte: If both your home and your workplace lie within the border zone, your salary is taxed in your country of residence — France, not Germany. A certificate from the French tax office is required.

grenzgaengerCH.texte: Cross-border commuters face split taxation with a capped withholding tax. Not returning home regularly after work forfeits this status.

grenzgaengerGeneral.titre: Taxation in the country of employment
grenzgaengerGeneral.texte: No special cross-border rule exists with this state: your salary is generally taxed where you work. The 183-day rule becomes decisive.

splittingPossible.texte: Even though your spouse lives abroad, you can opt for joint assessment. You need the EU/EEA certificate, confirmed by the tax authority of your home country.

splittingRefuseRevenus.titre: Joint assessment out of reach for now
splittingRefuseRevenus.texte: Only {part} of your combined income is taxed in Germany. You need 90 percent — or foreign income below twice the basic allowance.

splittingRefusePays.texte: Joint assessment with a spouse abroad requires residence in the EU or EEA. You will therefore be taxed as a single person.

optionIllimitee.titre: Applying for unlimited liability is worthwhile
optionIllimitee.texte: Almost all of your income comes from Germany. On application you receive the basic allowance, special expenses and family benefits like a resident.

pasDeGrundfreibetrag.titre: No basic allowance under limited liability
pasDeGrundfreibetrag.texte: Outside employment income the basic allowance of {montant} is not granted. In practice your tax starts at the first euro.

obligationDeclaration.titre: You must file a tax return
obligationDeclaration.texte: In your situation filing is mandatory, not optional. Missed deadlines trigger late-filing penalties.

kindergeldEU.texte: Entitlement generally exists even if the children live in another EU country. If the other parent already receives family benefits there, Germany pays the difference.

doubleImposition.texte: Germany and {pays} have a double taxation treaty. Which state taxes depends on the type of income: salary, rent, pensions and investment income follow different rules.

expat.resChecklistIndice: Order matters: no registration means no tax ID, and no tax ID means the wrong tax is withheld.

checklist.anmeldung: Register your address at the Bürgeramt (within 14 days)
checklist.steuerId: Wait for your tax identification number and pass it to your employer
checklist.lohnsteuerabzug: Have your payroll tax details and tax class checked
checklist.sozialversicherung: Sort out your social security number and health fund
checklist.ansaessigkeitsbescheinigung: Obtain a certificate of residence from your local tax office
checklist.a1Bescheinigung: Apply for the A1 social security certificate
checklist.abmeldung: Deregister at the Bürgeramt and plan your final tax return
checklist.wegzugsbesteuerung: Check exit taxation (if you hold shares in a company)
checklist.bescheinigungEUEWR: Have the EU/EEA certificate confirmed by the foreign tax authority
checklist.kindergeldAntrag: Apply for child benefit at the Familienkasse
checklist.elsterZugang: Set up ELSTER access (the certificate arrives by post)
checklist.unterlagenHeimatland: Keep proof of income from your home country for the relevant period

expat.ctaEtiquette: Initial consultation in English, German or French
expat.ctaTexte: We map out your situation in the meeting and show which topics are relevant to you — in English, German or French. The tax assessment and the return itself go through a cooperating certified tax advisor.
expat.avertissement: Simplified estimate. How a double taxation treaty actually applies always depends on the individual case — especially for pensions, rental income, investment income and secondments.
expat.stand: Law as at {annee} · parameters verified on {date}

honorar.titre: What does a German tax adviser cost?
honorar.sousTitre: Your fee under the statutory StBVV schedule — with the legal basis for every single item.
honorar.sectionProfilIndice: This preselects the usual services; you can adjust them afterwards.
honorar.sectionPrestationsIndice: The amount on the right shows the median fee per year for that service.

einkommensteuer.description: Basis: sum of positive income, minimum €8,000

jahresabschluss.description: Balance sheet and profit and loss account

koerperschaftsteuer.description: For GmbH, UG and other corporations

honorar.sectionChiffresIndice: Rough figures are fine — they set the basis of assessment and therefore the fee.

mieteinnahmen.label: Annual rental income
mieteinnahmen.indice: The higher of rental income or related expenses counts.

betriebsausgaben.label: Annual business expenses
betriebsausgaben.indice: The basis uses whichever of the two figures is higher.

bilanzsumme.label: Balance sheet total
bilanzsumme.indice: The basis is the average of balance sheet total and annual output.

ustPeriodicite.label: VAT filing frequency
ustPeriodicite.indice: Monthly for new businesses and higher VAT liabilities.

honorar.resultatSousTexte: Statutory range {min} to {max} · roughly {mois} per month
honorar.detailIndice: The median fee is applied — the usual starting point.
honorar.aucunePrestationTexte: Tick what you need above — the calculation appears immediately.
honorar.explicationTitre: Why a range instead of a fixed price?
honorar.explicationTexte: The StBVV sets a fee range for each service. Within that range the amount depends on volume, difficulty and liability risk. Well-prepared records noticeably reduce the fee.
honorar.pauschalTexte: For recurring work — bookkeeping, payroll, periodic returns — we are happy to agree a fixed monthly fee, so you know your budget for the whole year.
honorar.ctaTexte: In 15 minutes we scope your needs and you receive a written fixed-price offer. Reserved activities are the responsibility of an independent tax adviser (Steuerberater).
honorar.avertissement: Non-binding calculation based on the median fee. The actual fee is set according to the circumstances of the case (§ 11 StBVV); a separate fee agreement under § 4 StBVV remains possible.

rechtsform.sousTitre: Four legal forms calculated on the same profit — trade tax, corporation tax, director's salary and dividends.
rechtsform.sectionBeneficeIndice: Profit before the director's salary. That salary is the real lever: it reduces the company's profit, never the sole trader's.
rechtsform.remunerationIndice: A sole trader pays themselves no salary: the entire profit is their income.
rechtsform.quoteDistributionIndice: What stays in the company is not lost, merely taxed later. That is exactly where the corporate form wins.
rechtsform.sectionCommuneIndice: The municipal multiplier drives the trade tax — and you choose it when you choose your registered office.
rechtsform.hebesatzIndice: Up to {neutre} %, trade tax is fully credited against a sole trader's income tax.
rechtsform.splittingIndice: Married or in a registered partnership.
rechtsform.resultatSousTexte: Up to {montant} apart from the least favourable option

freiberufler.description: No trade tax, no commercial register entry

einzelunternehmen.description: Trade tax with allowance, credited under § 35 EStG

ug.description: Like a GmbH but from €1 capital, with a mandatory reserve

postes.anrechnungIndice: Capped at four times the base amount.

rechtsform.valeurCreee: What you are left with overall
rechtsform.valeurCreeeIndice: Personally available plus retained profit, discounted for the tax due on a later distribution. This is the figure the ranking uses.
rechtsform.resteDansSocieteIndice: A later distribution will still attract withholding tax.
rechtsform.reserveObligatoireIndice: A UG must retain 25 % of annual profit until the reserve reaches €25,000.

thesaurierung.titre: A company defers the tax, it does not save it
thesaurierung.texte: What stays inside the GmbH or UG is taxed at roughly 30 % for now — but distributing it later adds another {decote}. That is why this comparison discounts retained profits. The corporate form wins if you reinvest; take everything out and the sole trader is usually cheaper.

hebesatzEleve.titre: Multiplier above {neutre} % — trade tax is no longer fully credited
hebesatzEleve.texte: The portion above that threshold is a genuine extra burden for a sole trader. Moving to a neighbouring municipality can save several thousand euros a year.

hebesatzNeutre.titre: Multiplier up to {neutre} % — trade tax effectively neutral
hebesatzNeutre.texte: The credit under § 35 EStG fully offsets the trade tax for a sole trader. The disadvantage against a liberal profession then disappears in practice.

stammkapital.titre: Share capital: UG from {ug}, GmbH from {gmbh}
stammkapital.texte: The UG lowers the entry barrier but often looks less solid to banks and large customers. It can be converted into a GmbH later.

ugRuecklage.titre: A UG may not distribute its full profit
ugRuecklage.texte: 25 % of annual profit must go to the statutory reserve until it reaches €25,000. Only then is full distribution possible.

angemessenheit.titre: The director's salary must be reasonable
angemessenheit.texte: An excessive salary is reclassified by the tax office as a hidden distribution and assessed accordingly. The arm's-length comparison decides — we run it with you.

hypotheses.texte: A controlling shareholder-director, therefore outside compulsory social insurance — which keeps the comparison with the sole trader fair. Trade tax add-backs and reductions, and the option for partial income taxation of dividends, are not modelled.

rechtsform.ctaTexte: The legal form commits you for decades: liability, financing, succession and tax all hang on it. We calculate your actual case, conversion costs included.
rechtsform.avertissement: Simplified comparison of the ongoing tax burden. Not included: formation and conversion costs, accounting fees, liability considerations, social insurance, or trade tax add-backs and reductions.

kleinunternehmer.titre: Small business VAT exemption or standard VAT?
kleinunternehmer.sousTitre: Section 19 helps you with private customers and hurts you with business customers. This calculator shows where you stand.
kleinunternehmer.sectionChiffreAffairesIndice: What matters is the amount your customers pay.
kleinunternehmer.premiereAnneeIndice: In the year you start, only the current-year threshold applies.
kleinunternehmer.vorjahresumsatzIndice: Above {limite}, the exemption falls away the following year.
kleinunternehmer.sectionClienteleIndice: This is the real lever behind the decision.
kleinunternehmer.partParticuliersIndice: Private customers look at the final price: without VAT you keep more. Business customers reclaim VAT anyway — the exemption gains you nothing there.
kleinunternehmer.sectionDepensesIndice: Only costs carrying VAT count. Enter net amounts.
kleinunternehmer.investissementIndice: One large purchase can justify standard VAT on its own.
kleinunternehmer.satzReduitIndice: Books, food, passenger transport, cultural services.
kleinunternehmer.resultatNonEligible: You do not meet the conditions
kleinunternehmer.resultatNonEligibleTexte: The § 19 UStG thresholds are exceeded — standard VAT is mandatory.
kleinunternehmer.tvaNonFactureeIndice: Your gain with private customers: at the same final price, it stays with you.
kleinunternehmer.vorsteuerPerdueIndice: Your loss: under the exemption, VAT on your costs becomes a permanent expense.
kleinunternehmer.seuilBasculeIndice: Above this share of private customers, the exemption pays off.

grenzeVorjahrDepassee.texte: The exemption is therefore unavailable this year. You must charge VAT and file periodic returns.

grenzeLaufendDepassee.titre: The {limite} limit was exceeded during the year
grenzeLaufendDepassee.texte: Since 2025 the exemption ends immediately with the transaction that breaches the limit — not at year end. VAT is due from that invoice onwards.

basculeAnneeProchaine.titre: Exempt this year, not next year
basculeAnneeProchaine.texte: Your turnover exceeds {limite}. You stay exempt this year but switch to standard VAT on 1 January without exception. Reprice in good time.

investissement.texte: That is what the tax office would refund you under standard VAT. On a large purchase it often settles the question by itself.

renonciationInteressante.titre: Waiving the exemption is worth {montant} a year
renonciationInteressante.texte: Your customer mix and input VAT argue for standard VAT. The waiver is declared informally to the tax office.

franchiseInteressante.titre: The exemption is worth {montant} a year
franchiseInteressante.texte: Keep it. You also save the periodic returns and part of your ongoing bookkeeping.

bindung.texte: Waive the exemption and you cannot return for five calendar years. That decision deserves a calculation, not a shrug.

clienteleProfessionnelle.titre: With business customers the gross price is irrelevant
clienteleProfessionnelle.texte: Your customers reclaim the VAT: only your net price matters to them. The supposed price advantage of the exemption disappears entirely here.

chargeAdministrative.titre: The admin burden belongs in the calculation
chargeAdministrative.texte: Standard VAT means periodic returns, tracking deductible input VAT and strict invoicing requirements. Our fee calculator shows what that costs.

kleinunternehmer.ctaTexte: Five years of commitment deserve a proper calculation. We go through your figures, your customer mix and your planned investments with you; the periodic returns run through a cooperating certified tax advisor.
kleinunternehmer.avertissement: Simplified comparison. Not included: intra-EU supplies and reverse charge, margin scheme, mixed rates, and the input VAT adjustment under § 15a UStG when switching regimes.

firmenwagen.sousTitre: What matters is not the benefit in kind, but what the car actually takes out of your net pay.
firmenwagen.sectionVehiculeIndice: The gross list price at first registration is what counts — not the price actually paid.
firmenwagen.anschaffungRecenteIndice: Before that date the quarter rate applied only up to €70,000 rather than €100,000.
firmenwagen.distanceTravailIndice: One way, by the shortest road route.
firmenwagen.joursTravaillesIndice: 220 is the usual figure. Fewer if you work from home.
firmenwagen.sectionSalaireIndice: The benefit in kind is taxed at your personal rate, so your salary is decisive.
firmenwagen.sectionCarnetIndice: Only fill this in if you know the actual costs.
firmenwagen.carnetActifIndice: Worthwhile mainly with low private use and expensive vehicles.
firmenwagen.coutAnnuelVehiculeIndice: Depreciation, insurance, road tax, servicing, fuel or electricity.
firmenwagen.kmPrivesIndice: Excluding commuting — the calculator works that out itself.
firmenwagen.resultatEtiquette: Your company car costs you, net
firmenwagen.carnetInactif: Switch on the logbook comparison and enter your actual costs.
firmenwagen.detailTitre: How the figure builds up (1 % rule)
firmenwagen.trajetsTravailIndice: per kilometre of distance, here {km} km

economieElectrique.titre: Going electric saves you {montant} a year
economieElectrique.texte: The same list price as a combustion car would cost you {thermique} a month instead of {actuel}. The quarter rate is the single most powerful lever on a company car.

electriqueAvantage.titre: Quarter rate applies (list price up to {plafond})
electriqueAvantage.texte: Only a quarter of the list price is taken into account, for private use and commuting alike.

electriqueAuDessusPlafond.titre: Above {plafond}: only half the assessment basis
electriqueAuDessusPlafond.texte: Beyond the price cap the quarter rate gives way to the half rate. A few thousand euros less on the list price can be worth a great deal over several years.

plafondAncien.texte: Vehicles provided before 01.07.2025 keep the old price cap. The date the car was made available governs, not the tax year.

hybrideConditions.texte: Halving the basis requires a minimum electric range or low emissions. If the car misses them, the full 1 % rule applies.

carnetInteressant.titre: The logbook saves you {montant} a year
carnetInteressant.texte: Your private share is low enough to justify the effort. The method is chosen for the whole year and per vehicle.

forfaitInteressant.titre: The 1 % rule works out better for you
forfaitInteressant.texte: The gap is {montant} a year in favour of the flat rate — with far less effort.

carnetNonRenseigne.texte: Without total costs and mileage the second method cannot be assessed. Switch the comparison on once you have the figures.

carnetExigences.titre: A logbook must be complete and contemporaneous
carnetExigences.texte: Date, odometer, destination, purpose and contact for every trip — recorded as you go and tamper-proof. Spreadsheets are rejected, and the 1 % rule then applies retrospectively.

entfernungspauschale.titre: Do not forget the {montant} commuting deduction
entfernungspauschale.texte: Even with a company car, commuting remains deductible. The relief lands in your annual return, not in the monthly payroll deduction.

einzelbewertung.titre: At {jours} working days, per-trip valuation is worth it
einzelbewertung.texte: Below 180 commutes a year you may use 0.002 % per actual trip instead of a flat 0.03 % per month. Your employer has to apply it.

firmenwagen.ctaEtiquette: Set the company car up properly
firmenwagen.ctaTexte: Method, electric price cap, charging and salary sacrifice: on a company car the details are worth four-figure sums. We calculate your specific set-up.
firmenwagen.avertissement: Simplified calculation. Not included: employee contributions to costs, charging and wallbox, family home journeys under a dual household, pool vehicles, and flat-rate taxation of travel allowances.

immobilien.sousTitre: After-tax yield, depreciation and rental losses — based on your own figures.
immobilien.sectionBienIndice: Purchase price excluding costs — the calculator adds those itself.
immobilien.partTerrainIndice: Only the building is depreciated, never the land. An inflated land share costs you depreciation every single year.
immobilien.sectionAmortissementIndice: The rate depends on the year of completion.
immobilien.interetsAnnuelsIndice: Only interest is deductible — capital repayment is not.
immobilien.remboursementCapitalIndice: Drains your cash flow without reducing tax.
immobilien.sectionFiscaliteIndice: Your other income determines what a loss is worth.
immobilien.resultatEtiquette: Your monthly cash flow after tax
immobilien.detailFiscalIndice: An excess of costs over rent reduces your overall income tax.

fraisAcquisition.texte: No bank finances these. They do increase the depreciable base, to the extent they relate to the building.

deficit.titre: The rental loss saves you {montant} in tax
deficit.texte: It offsets your other income. At a marginal rate of {taux}, the tax office effectively pays a large share of your interest.

benefice.texte: Your rent exceeds interest, costs and depreciation. Check whether maintenance work can be brought forward.

terrain.texte: The split between land and building fixes your depreciation for decades. It belongs in the purchase contract — the tax office rarely accepts it afterwards.

speculation.texte: Selling within that period makes the gain taxable. Living in the property yourself in the year of sale and the {ansUsage} preceding years removes the tax entirely.

degressif.texte: You write off far more in the early years and less later. A one-off switch to straight-line remains possible.

tilgung.titre: Capital repayment of {montant} is not deductible
tilgung.texte: It leaves your account without reducing tax — the classic reason a property can be profitable on paper yet tight on cash.

immobilien.ctaEtiquette: Run the numbers before the notary
immobilien.ctaTexte: Price allocation, depreciation choice and financing structure fix your tax position for decades. Afterwards there is little left to correct.
immobilien.avertissement: Simplified first-year calculation. Not included: vacancy and rent arrears, deferred maintenance, special depreciation, acquisition-related production costs, and future movements in rent and interest rates.

kaufnebenkosten.sousTitre: Transfer tax, notary, land registry and agent — the sum no bank will finance.
kaufnebenkosten.courtierIndice: Since 2020 the commission on residential property is generally shared.
kaufnebenkosten.apportIndice: The purchase costs must be fully covered from it.
kaufnebenkosten.notaireIndice: Deed and execution, set by statute.

apportInsuffisant.titre: Your equity does not cover the purchase costs
apportInsuffisant.texte: You need at least {montant} for tax, notary and agent alone. Banks virtually never finance these — it is the most common reason a mortgage falls through.

apportSuffisant.texte: The main hurdle is cleared. Anything beyond that noticeably lowers your interest rate.

ecartLand.titre: In Bavaria it would be {montant} less
ecartLand.texte: The lowest rate in Germany is {taux}. Worth considering for an investment property; rarely for a home you will live in.

courtier.texte: Freely negotiable, even if it is rarely presented that way. Buying directly from the owner removes it entirely.

mobilier.titre: Fixtures bought with the property reduce the tax
mobilier.texte: A fitted kitchen, awning or sauna are not part of the land. If their value is stated separately in the contract, no transfer tax is due on it.

delaiPaiement.titre: The tax arrives sooner than expected
delaiPaiement.texte: The assessment follows a few weeks after signing and is due within a month. Without the clearance certificate there is no land registry entry.

kaufnebenkosten.ctaTexte: We review your purchase costs, the price allocation and the tax structure — before you sit down at the notary.
kaufnebenkosten.avertissement: Notary and land registry fees are typical values under the GNotKG; only the notary's own invoice is binding. Agent commissions vary by region and are negotiable.

photovoltaik.sousTitre: The 30 kWp limit decides — below it everything stays tax-free, above it the system becomes a business.
photovoltaik.sectionInstallationIndice: The gross output recorded in the market register is what counts.
photovoltaik.unites: Residential and commercial units in the building
photovoltaik.unitesIndice: The limit applies per unit — it multiplies in an apartment block.
photovoltaik.autresInstallationsIndice: All systems of one taxpayer count together.
photovoltaik.sectionRendementIndice: Reference values you can adjust to your quote.
photovoltaik.tauxMarginalIndice: Only relevant if the system is not exempt.
photovoltaik.resultatSousTexte: The system pays for itself after {ans} years
photovoltaik.limitesIndice: Both must be met, otherwise the exemption is lost entirely.

exonere.titre: Tax-free — {montant} a year with no income tax
exonere.texte: Your system stays below {limite}. Neither the feed-in tariff nor self-consumption is taxed, and no profit calculation is required.

depasseObjet.texte: At {puissance} kWp you lose the exemption entirely — there is no partial relief. A few panels fewer can save several hundred euros a year.

depasseContribuable.texte: Your systems total {total} kWp. Above that threshold every system becomes taxable, including the small ones.

tauxZero.texte: Supply and installation on a residential building are invoiced without VAT. Nothing to apply for, no option to exercise.

kleinunternehmer.titre: Staying VAT-exempt is now the right call
kleinunternehmer.texte: Operators used to waive the exemption to reclaim VAT on the purchase. With the zero rate there is no VAT to reclaim — waiving brings only paperwork.

euerRequise.texte: Without the exemption the system becomes a business: cash-basis accounts, Schedule G and depreciation over twenty years.

gewerbeanmeldung.texte: The tax exemption does not remove the duty to register in the market data register and notify the tax office.

photovoltaik.ctaTexte: System size, battery and ownership structure decide the exemption. We review your quote before you sign.
photovoltaik.avertissement: Simplified profitability calculation. Not included: panel degradation, inverter replacement, insurance, storage losses, financing costs, and future movements in electricity and feed-in prices.

abfindung.sousTitre: The one-fifth rule softens the progression — but since 2025 only in your tax return, no longer on your payslip.
abfindung.revenuRestant: Other taxable income in the payment year
abfindung.revenuRestantIndice: Salary up to your leaving date; unemployment benefit does not count here.
abfindung.sectionTimingIndice: The single most powerful lever: in a year without salary the rate is far lower.
abfindung.versementAnneeSuivanteIndice: Often negotiable — the settlement agreement fixes it.
abfindung.revenuAnneeSuivanteIndice: New salary, pension, or zero if unemployed.

methodesIndice.ordinaire: The severance is added in full to the year's income.
methodesIndice.cinquieme: Taxed as if spread over five years.

abfindung.economieIndice: The tax office automatically applies whichever is more favourable.
abfindung.decalageTitre: What deferring to next year would bring

cinquiemeApplique.texte: The progression effect is softened: tax is computed on one fifth and then multiplied by five.

cinquiemeSansEffet.texte: Your other income already sits at the top rate. One fifth of the severance is then taxed at that same rate.

plusDePrelevement.titre: Since {annee} your employer no longer applies the rule
plusDePrelevement.texte: The payslip taxes at the full rate first — so your account shows less than you are entitled to. You recover the difference only through your tax return.

declarationObligatoire.texte: The rule is granted only on application in the assessment. Not filing means giving up the entire amount.

decalage.texte: Paid in January, the severance lands in a lower-income year. That belongs in the settlement agreement — it cannot be arranged afterwards.

zusammenballung.texte: Split across two years, the severance generally loses the benefit of the rule. Small partial payments of up to half are tolerated.
zusammenballung.reference: Federal Fiscal Court case law on § 34 EStG

sozialversicherung.texte: A genuine severance for loss of employment is exempt. Back pay or holiday compensation, however, is not.

abfindung.ctaTexte: Payment date, concentration and staging decide four- and five-figure sums — and can only be negotiated before the settlement agreement is signed.
abfindung.avertissement: Simplified calculation. Not included: church tax, the effect of unemployment benefit on your rate, occupational pensions, and remuneration for multi-year activity.

altersvorsorge.sousTitre: What you will be short — and what Rürup or Riester really cost after tax and subsidies.
altersvorsorge.enfantsIndice: Each child substantially increases the Riester subsidy.
altersvorsorge.sectionBesoinIndice: As a share of your current gross income.
altersvorsorge.sectionEpargneIndice: The amount you can set aside each year.
altersvorsorge.resultatSousTexte: Expected net pension {rente} · {ans} years still to go
altersvorsorge.renteIndice: Estimated from the headline pension level — only your own pension statement is reliable.

ruerup.description: Fully deductible, but a lifelong annuity with no lump sum.

riester.description: Subsidies rather than tax relief — very strong with children.

deficit.titre: You will be {montant} short each month
deficit.texte: The gap grows with every year you wait — compound interest only works with time.

pasDeDeficit.texte: On these assumptions the state pension covers your need. Still consider inflation and long-term care risk.

estimationRente.texte: It assumes a pension level of {part} of gross income. Your actual pension depends on your whole contribution history — your annual pension statement is the only reliable source.

impositionRente.texte: The taxable share depends on the year you retire and is then fixed for life. Retiring in {annee} no longer gives you a lower share.

ruerup.texte: Contributions are fully deductible up to {plafond}. The higher your rate today, the stronger the effect.

plafondRuerupAtteint.texte: Contributions above it bring no further tax relief. Other vehicles make more sense for the remainder.

riesterEnfants.texte: With {enfants} child(ren), Riester beats Rürup almost every time — the subsidies do not depend on your tax rate.

ruerupIrrevocable.texte: No lump sum, no cancellation, no inheritance without an add-on. The tax relief is bought with maximum commitment.

altersvorsorge.ctaTexte: Rürup, Riester, occupational pension or a plain portfolio: the right answer depends on your tax rate, your children and your horizon. We model every route.
altersvorsorge.avertissement: Rough orientation, not investment advice. Not included: inflation, product charges, pension increases, incapacity, and your actual contribution history.

erbschaft.sousTitre: Allowances, tax class and the ten-year rule — the only three levers there are.
erbschaft.donationIndice: Rather than inheritance — same allowances, but repeatable.
erbschaft.beneficiairesIndice: Each recipient has their own allowance.
erbschaft.sectionLienIndice: It sets the allowance and the tax class — and therefore almost everything.
erbschaft.detailIndice: Tax is calculated separately for each recipient.
erbschaft.versorgungIndice: Only on death, reduced by survivor pensions.
erbschaft.etalementIndice: Two gifts {ans} years apart instead of a single transfer.

sousAbattement.texte: Nothing is due at this value. A notification to the tax office may still be required.

impotDu.texte: In class {classe} the rate applies to the whole taxable amount, not in bands. Just above a threshold that gets expensive — a hardship adjustment only softens it.

etalement.texte: Allowances refresh every {ans} years. Starting early lets you transfer the same assets in stages, almost tax-free.

classeDefavorable.texte: Outside the immediate family the allowance drops to €20,000 and rates start between 15 and 30 percent. Adoption, marriage or a corporate structure can change that — with major consequences elsewhere.

versorgungsfreibetrag.texte: Available only to the surviving spouse or partner, reduced by the capital value of tax-free survivor pensions.

immobilier.texte: Not market value but the value under the valuation act applies. An owner-occupied family home can be entirely exempt for spouse and children, provided they live there for ten years.

delaiDeclaration.texte: Both inheritance and gift must be notified to the tax office within three months, whether or not tax is due.

erbschaft.ctaTexte: The ten-year rule only works if you start early enough. We review allowances, valuation and usufruct — and model the staging for your family.
erbschaft.avertissement: Simplified calculation. Not included: valuation of property and business assets, relief for family businesses, usufruct, forced heirship claims, the hardship adjustment, and transfers within the previous ten years.

erklaerungspflicht.titre: Do I have to file a tax return?
erklaerungspflicht.sousTitre: Mandatory or voluntary — and by when. Two questions rarely answered together.
erklaerungspflicht.avecConseilIndice: An engagement extends the deadline automatically, with no application.
erklaerungspflicht.sectionMotifs: Does any of these apply to you?
erklaerungspflicht.sectionMotifsIndice: A single one is enough to make filing mandatory.

revenusAnnexes.titre: Side income or wage replacement benefits
revenusAnnexes.description: Rental income, pensions, parental allowance, short-time or unemployment benefit

plusieursEmployeurs.titre: More than one employer at a time
plusieursEmployeurs.description: Second job in tax class VI

classeVouFacteur.titre: Tax classes III/V or IV with factor
classeVouFacteur.description: Applies to almost every couple with unequal incomes

freibetrag.description: Allowance applied at the wage tax deduction

abfindung.description: Extraordinary income taxed at a reduced rate

ehegattenWechsel.titre: Divorce or death of a spouse with remarriage

demandeFinanzamt.titre: The tax office asked you to file

erklaerungspflicht.sectionVolontairesIndice: Even without an obligation, most employees get money back.

emploiPartiel.titre: Did not work the full year

mariageRecent.description: The splitting benefit often only arrives via the return

dons.titre: Donations or work on your home

erklaerungspflicht.delaisIndice: The deadline extends purely by virtue of the engagement, with no application.

obligatoire.texte: Filing is required, not optional. Letting the deadline pass invites an estimated assessment, rarely in your favour.

retard.titre: Being late costs from the first month
retard.texte: The surcharge is {part} of the assessed tax per month started, at least {minimum} a month. Where filing is mandatory it is applied as a matter of course.

volontaireRentable.texte: You ticked {nombre} item(s) that typically lead to a refund. On average, employees get four-figure sums back.

aucuneObligation.texte: On your answers, nothing requires you to file. A voluntary return remains possible — and usually worthwhile.

quatreAns.titre: Four years instead of a few months
quatreAns.texte: Without an obligation you can file up to four years back. The older years are often the most rewarding — and the most often forgotten.

gainDelai.texte: The extended deadline applies automatically once an engagement exists. Not the main reason to appoint an adviser, but a real side effect.

sousSeuil.texte: It therefore triggers no filing obligation. For wage replacement benefits, however, the rate effect applies even below that.

abfindung.titre: Severance: the return is worth real money
abfindung.texte: Since 2025 employers no longer apply the one-fifth rule. Only the assessment recovers the difference.

erklaerungspflicht.ctaTexte: We map out your situation, go through the open years and support the return via a cooperating certified tax advisor — with the extended deadline.
erklaerungspflicht.avertissement: Orientation only, not a definitive assessment. § 46 EStG contains further grounds; your actual circumstances govern. Deadlines may differ by individual order of the tax office.

unterhalt.titre: Deducting money sent to family back home
unterhalt.sousTitre: Supporting parents or siblings abroad is tax-deductible — few people know it, and fewer still know the conditions.
unterhalt.sectionEnvoisIndice: Total for one calendar year, across everyone you support.
unterhalt.nombrePersonnesIndice: Each person has their own ceiling.
unterhalt.moisSoutien: Months in which you provided support
unterhalt.parVirementIndice: Decisive: since 2025, cash and money carried home on a visit are no longer deductible.
unterhalt.sectionPaysIndice: The tax office reduces the ceiling according to local living standards. Your group is set out in the Federal Ministry of Finance circular — we check it with you.
unterhalt.sectionBeneficiaireIndice: Only relatives with a statutory maintenance claim qualify: parents, grandparents, children, spouse. Siblings do not.
unterhalt.conjointBeneficiaireIndice: For a spouse the Opfergrenze does not apply.
unterhalt.beneficiaireApteAuTravailIndice: Anyone who could work is expected to: the tax office then refuses the deduction.
unterhalt.revenusPersonneIndice: Pension, rent, wages — anything above €624 is set off.
unterhalt.sectionPayeurIndice: Determines your Opfergrenze and your tax rate.
unterhalt.enfantsPayeur: My own children receiving child benefit
unterhalt.enfantsPayeurIndice: Each child lowers the Opfergrenze by a further 5 points.
unterhalt.resultatSousTexte: {deductible} deductible at a marginal rate of {taux}
unterhalt.resultatBloqueTexte: One condition is not met — see the points below.
unterhalt.detailTitre: How the figure is built up
unterhalt.detailIndice: The ceiling applies per person supported.
unterhalt.plafondPleinIndice: group {groupe}, that is {part} of the basic allowance

especesRefusees.titre: Cash has not been deductible since {annee}
especesRefusees.texte: Only transfers to an account held by the person supported are accepted. Money handed over in person on a visit no longer counts, not even with witnesses or a receipt. It is the single most common reason for refusal.

virementObligatoire.titre: Send money only by bank transfer
virementObligatoire.texte: Since 2025 only transfers to an account of the person supported are deductible. Keep every receipt — it is your only proof.

erwerbsobliegenheit.titre: The duty to work blocks the deduction
erwerbsobliegenheit.texte: For someone able to work and under 65, the tax office assumes they can support themselves. The deduction succeeds only with evidence to the contrary: illness, caring duties, documented unemployment.

laendergruppe.texte: For that country the ceiling drops to {plafond} instead of the full basic allowance. The cut surprises almost everyone: it follows local living standards, not what you actually send.

opfergrenze.texte: Outside marriage the tax office recognises at most {part} of your net income — the assumption being that nobody can give more without putting themselves at risk.

revenusBeneficiaire.texte: Everything above the {seuil} threshold is deducted from the ceiling. A modest pension back home can shrink the benefit considerably.

zwoelftelung.texte: The ceiling is cut by one twelfth for every month without support. Regular monthly transfers therefore beat a single payment in December.

plafonne.texte: Your payments exceed the recognised amount. The excess is lost for tax purposes — where several people are supported, splitting the payments often avoids this.

justificatifs.texte: A maintenance declaration signed by the person supported on the official form, proof of their address, evidence of their own income, and every transfer receipt. If one is missing, the whole deduction fails.

vermoegen.titre: They must not hold significant assets
vermoegen.texte: Above roughly {limite} in assets the deduction disappears. A home they occupy themselves is generally left out of that assessment.

groupeAVerifier.titre: Your country group is worth checking
groupeAVerifier.texte: The classification is revised annually by the Federal Ministry of Finance and countries do move between groups. We verify yours — the wrong group shifts the result substantially.

unterhalt.ctaEtiquette: Retroactive for up to four years
unterhalt.ctaTexte: If you have never claimed this, you can usually still go back four years. We review your transfers, obtain the forms for your family and handle the return.
unterhalt.avertissement: Simplified calculation. Not included: support to several people living in different countries, payments shared between several supporters, benefits in kind, and the precise determination of net income for the Opfergrenze.

kindergeldAusland.titre: Child benefit for children living abroad
kindergeldAusland.sousTitre: Three countries of residence, three completely different answers — and an allowance that survives even without benefit.
kindergeldAusland.sectionResidenceIndice: What matters is the child's residence, not your nationality.

abkommen.description: Algeria, Bosnia, Kosovo, Morocco, Montenegro, Serbia, Tunisia, Türkiye

kindergeldAusland.activiteCotisante: I am in employment subject to social insurance
kindergeldAusland.activiteCotisanteIndice: Or receiving unemployment or sickness benefit. Without that the treaty does not apply.
kindergeldAusland.prestationsEtranger: Family benefits in the country of residence
kindergeldAusland.prestationsEtrangerIndice: Whatever is already paid there reduces the German benefit.
kindergeldAusland.sectionGroupeIndice: It determines how much of the child allowance remains.
kindergeldAusland.revenuImposableIndice: Determines what the allowance is worth.
kindergeldAusland.resultatSansAllocation: No child benefit — but the child allowance still remains yours

abattement.description: Works through the tax return, grows with your tax rate.

kindergeldAusland.detailIndice: The tax office automatically applies whichever is better for you.
kindergeldAusland.allocationPleine: Child benefit at the full rate
kindergeldAusland.avantageRetenuIndice: The better of the two routes.
kindergeldAusland.ecartAllemagne: Shortfall against children living in Germany
kindergeldAusland.ecartAllemagneIndice: What the same family would receive with children in Germany.

regimeUE.texte: If your children live in the EU, the EEA or Switzerland, your entitlement is the same as if they lived in Germany.

differenzzahlung.texte: If {montant} in family benefits is already paid in the country of residence, Germany pays only the difference. There is no double payment.

regimeAbkommen.titre: Entitlement under the social security agreement
regimeAbkommen.texte: An agreement links Germany to that state and extends entitlement to children living there. It still requires employment subject to social insurance in Germany.

montantConventionnel.texte: For children in treaty states the amount paid is often lower than the German rate. The exact figure comes from the agreement — we look it up for your country.

abkommenSansActivite.texte: The agreement applies only while you are in employment subject to social insurance in Germany, or receiving unemployment or sickness benefit. Self-employment generally does not qualify.

regimeDrittstaat.titre: No child benefit for a child in a third country
regimeDrittstaat.texte: The territoriality principle rules out entitlement where the child lives neither in the EU nor in a treaty state. Neither your nationality nor your residence permit changes that.

macedoine.titre: North Macedonia is not a treaty state
macedoine.texte: Unlike neighbouring Serbia, Montenegro and Kosovo, no such agreement exists. This confusion regularly leads to rejected claims.

abattementReduit.texte: In group {groupe}, {part} of the allowance remains. But it never disappears entirely — you can claim it even without child benefit.

abattementPlusFavorable.texte: At your income the child allowance outweighs the benefit. The tax office automatically applies the better option — but only if you file a return.

ecartAllemagne.titre: {montant} less than with children in Germany
ecartAllemagne.texte: That is the gap caused purely by where your children live. Check whether your payments are deductible as family support under § 33a EStG.

titreSejour.texte: For non-EU nationals, child benefit requires a settlement permit or a residence permit allowing work. A mere toleration and certain temporary permits do not suffice.

unterhaltAlternative.titre: Without benefit, the support deduction remains
unterhaltAlternative.texte: Payments to children abroad who do not qualify for child benefit are deductible as maintenance under § 33a EStG. That is the way out many families miss — our family support calculator gives the figure.

kindergeldAusland.ctaTexte: Children's residence, residence permit and treaty position decide — and the benefits office often reads them narrowly. We review your case and appeal refusals.
kindergeldAusland.avertissement: Simplified presentation. The amount for treaty states depends on the applicable agreement and is calculated here at the full German rate. Not included: the ranking of children, children over 18 in education, and competing claims by the other parent.

rentenerstattung.titre: Going home: claim your pension contributions back?
rentenerstattung.sousTitre: A refund pays out immediately but erases every entitlement, permanently. Both routes in figures.
rentenerstattung.sectionCarriereIndice: Every month in which you paid German pension contributions.
rentenerstattung.salaireMoyenIndice: Across your whole contribution period. Earning exactly the national average yields one pension point per year.
rentenerstattung.moisDepuisDepartIndice: A refund is only possible after 24 months.
rentenerstattung.ressortissantUEIndice: Anyone still entitled to pay voluntary contributions gets no refund.
rentenerstattung.resultatConserver: Keep the entitlement: {pension} a month from 67 rather than {remboursement} once
rentenerstattung.resultatRembourser: Refund of {remboursement} — the contribution period creates no pension

conserver.description: Lifelong pension from 67, paid abroad too.

rembourser.description: One-off payment, after which everything is extinguished.

rentenerstattung.wartezeitIndice: Without it there is no pension entitlement.
rentenerstattung.pointsIndice: One point per year at average earnings.
rentenerstattung.pointEquilibreIndice: How long until the pension matches the refunded amount.
rentenerstattung.pensionCumuleeIndice: Based on an average period of receipt from 67.

ressortissantUE.titre: No refund for an EU national
ressortissantUE.texte: Anyone who may still contribute voluntarily is excluded from the refund. Your periods are aggregated with those of other member states in any case.

delaiNonEcoule.texte: The refund can only be claimed 24 months after compulsory insurance ends. The legislator wants to prevent hasty decisions.

wartezeitAtteinte.titre: You have a pension entitlement of {montant} a month
wartezeitAtteinte.texte: With more than {nombre} contribution years the general qualifying period is met. That entitlement lasts for life, even if you never work in Germany again.

wartezeitManquante.titre: {nombre} more contribution months to reach entitlement
wartezeitManquante.texte: Below five years no pension arises. Voluntary contributions can close the gap — often the better option than a refund.

partPatronalePerdue.texte: Only what you paid yourself is refunded, roughly half. The employer's share simply lapses. That is exactly what most people overlook.

irreversible.texte: The refund dissolves the insurance relationship: all periods, including child-raising and education periods, are erased. There is no way to buy them back.

pointEquilibre.titre: After {nombre} years of pension the refund is overtaken
pointEquilibre.texte: Beyond that point the pension will have paid you more than the lump sum. Over an average receipt period of 18 years the arithmetic is usually clear-cut.

versementEtranger.titre: The pension is paid abroad too
versementEtranger.texte: German pensions are transferred worldwide. The former reduction to 70 percent no longer applies to pensions starting from October 2013 — one more reason to keep the entitlement.

accordBilateral.titre: A social security agreement can change everything
accordBilateral.texte: Where an agreement links Germany to your home country, insurance periods there are added to the German ones. Many reach the five years they lack in Germany alone that way.

rentenerstattung.ctaTexte: The refund cannot be undone. We review your contribution record, possible treaty periods and the voluntary contribution option — before you file the application.
rentenerstattung.avertissement: Simplified estimate. Your actual pension follows from your record with the German pension insurance, including child-raising, credited and supplementary periods. Pension increases, deductions for early retirement and the taxation of the pension are not included.
rentenerstattung.stand: Pension values and § 210 SGB VI, as at {date}
